exclude_paths.reason: The coverage driver performs policy and pre-trace setup before starting its own tracer; recursively tracing the driver would change the measured workload.

limitations: The metric is executable-line coverage, not branch, condition or mutation coverage.
Python child processes are not merged into this in-process measurement; their command and release behaviour is covered by separate integration and reproducibility gates.
Browser JavaScript is outside this Python metric and is exercised by the required Chromium job.
The pinned enforcement runtime avoids cross-version bytecode line-table drift.
Operating-system-specific branches that cannot execute on the Linux coverage runner remain subject to the separate Windows and macOS validation jobs.
